tape_read.note: Robust reference $17.00 (-4.5% vs $17.80 prev close); premarket_last $17.60 (-1.1%) is one print. After-hours last $18.57 (+4.3%) points the other way, so the overnight read is conflicting. Only 5 prints, none in the last 30 minutes, last at 08:43: stale_at_open true. Against a -6.5% release read and three straight ~-7% prints, -4.5% is a mild undershoot, but inside the 12.4% implied move and on a tape too thin to trust, with small caps up 1.8% (IWM) pulling the other way. Short is already up ~8% from the $18.54 entry at the reference price (stock had fallen to $17.80 by yesterday's close).

thesis_check.note: Thesis was a short on forward framing after a run-up; the release delivers a lowered Q4/FY revenue guide and no above-top beat, which is the line the last three -7% reactions traded on. The 2027 number itself was not found.

expected.open_lag_note: Stale pre-market (5 prints, last 08:43) and an after-hours print at +4.3% against a -4.5% pre-market reference make the open unreliable either way, so p_open_lags is well above base. A gap on an amc print that had a full night tends to give some back after the open, and a strong small-cap tape (IWM +1.8%) adds to the fade risk for a short.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers bevestigen de short: de omzet kwam niet boven de eigen prognose uit en de omzetverwachting voor Q4 en heel 2026 is verlaagd. De short staat al flink in de plus, de voorbeurs is dun en tegenstrijdig (nabeurs omhoog, voorbeurs omlaag) en de markt staat stevig hoger, dus er is geen reden om van de standaardregel af te wijken: dekken bij de opening.
